findings.title: Exception handler always triggers unconditional branch due to 'or True'
findings.impact: Any exception raised during concurrent research unit execution in the supervisor tools handler will immediately abort the entire research phase and return END, even if it's a transient or non-token-limit error that could be handled or retried.
findings.preconditions: An exception occurs inside the try block of supervisor_tools when executing research tasks.
findings.explanation: In supervisor_tools, the exception check 'if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:' contains an unconditional 'or True' clause. This means the condition always evaluates to True, short-circuiting error differentiation and immediately terminating the research phase via a Command(goto=END, ...) return.

findings.title: Unconditional Exception Handling Catch-All in Supervisor Tools
findings.impact: Any unexpected exception, bug, system interruption, or cancellation during research execution is unconditionally caught and swallowed, terminating the research phase prematurely and returning incomplete or empty notes.
findings.preconditions: An exception occurs during research tasks execution in `supervisor_tools`.
findings.explanation: Line 334 contains `if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:`, which makes the condition always evaluate to `True`. As a result, all exceptions (including programming errors, timeouts, network disconnections) are treated as token limit or research failures and silently break the research loop.

findings.title: Exception handler masks all exceptions in supervisor_tools due to unconditional 'or True'
findings.impact: Any exception during research execution in supervisor_tools (including network timeouts, validation errors, or transient issues) is unconditionally caught and swallowed, abruptly ending the research phase instead of allowing retries or propagating the error.
findings.preconditions: An exception occurs during asyncio.gather(*research_tasks) inside supervisor_tools.
findings.explanation: Line 334 checks if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:, which always evaluates to True. Consequently, any raised exception triggers the token limit branch and immediately terminates research via Command(goto=END, ...) rather than handling non-token limit exceptions or retrying.
